confidence_notes: I ran three web searches. One looked up the RBA rate. The other two looked up Marmaris prices. The RBA figure is 0.6720 USD per AUD as at 18 November 2026, taken from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page. I did not open the page itself. Beer, coffee and restaurant meal anchors come from aggregated crowdsourced cost-of-living sources such as Numbeo, Nomad Watch and Oysterlist. Beer was about $3.0-3.6, cappuccino about $2.6-3.6, an inexpensive meal about $7-10, and a mid-range meal for two about $22-43. These sources differ widely. I weighted the mid-range meal toward tourist-area pricing in July, the peak season. I found no direct current price for cocktails or wine, so I set them from the local relationship to beer: cocktails at about 2.5 times beer and wine by the glass at about 1.5 times. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge of Turkish Aegean resort pricing in peak summer. I did not search accommodation prices or inspect any listings. They are the least certain anchors, because summer prices swing a lot.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to Turkish Aegean and Mediterranean resort towns such as Bodrum, Fethiye and Kuşadası. Marmaris is a high-volume package-tourism resort with prices below Bodrum and well below Greek-island equivalents.
